items.title: Remote viewing
items.summary: A named target protocol often grouped with clairvoyance; compare complete impressions against concealed targets.

items.title: Precognition & presentiment
items.summary: Reports interpreted as anticipating later events; retain dated records before any outcome is known.

items.title: Retrocognition
items.summary: Impressions interpreted as referring to past events; separate prior knowledge from later checks.

items.title: Telepathy
items.summary: Reports of apparent person-to-person information transfer; distinguish an impression from a demonstrated communication channel.

items.title: Psychometry
items.summary: Impressions associated with handling an object; record them before learning its provenance.

items.title: Clairaudience & clairsentience
items.summary: Subjective experiences described as inner hearing or feeling; terms and interpretations vary.

items.title: Oneiromancy
items.summary: Symbolic dream interpretation; related to dreams, with a different aim from recognizing a lucid dream.

items.title: Dream incubation
items.summary: Setting a question or intention before sleep and recording the dream on waking.

items.title: Hypnagogic imagery
items.summary: Images or sensations around sleep onset, recorded as experiences at the sleep boundary.

items.title: Dream yoga & yoga nidra
items.summary: Tradition-specific contemplative practices of dream and sleep; separate sources and methods are needed for each.

title: Reflective surfaces, fire & forms
scope: MATTER & HAND SCALES / FURTHER GAZING METHODS

items.title: Catoptromancy / mirror gazing
items.summary: Reading or contemplating reflected images, including dark mirrors; a further gazing surface.

items.title: Hydromancy
items.summary: Symbolic readings of water, its surface or motion.

items.title: Lecanomancy
items.summary: Basin readings, sometimes involving oil on water; often overlaps with hydromancy.

items.title: Pyromancy
items.summary: Symbolic observation of fire; candle gazing is already included as one related practice.

items.title: Capnomancy
items.summary: Symbolic observation of smoke and its changing forms.

items.title: Ceromancy
items.summary: Reading wax forms; distinct from observing a candle flame.

items.title: Lithomancy
items.summary: Readings using stones, their selection, casting or arrangement; methods differ.

items.title: Sand readings / psammomancy
items.summary: Patterns in sand or scattered grains; sometimes overlaps with geomancy.

items.title: Inkblot & incidental-image readings
items.summary: Symbolic responses to chance marks, stains or images; separate from clinical testing.

items.title: Geomancy
items.summary: Dot figures and their combinations; identify the named tradition and method rather than treating all earth readings as one system.

items.title: Bibliomancy & stichomancy
items.summary: Selecting a passage, line or verse from a book as a symbolic prompt.

items.title: Numerology / arithmancy
items.summary: Symbolic number systems; name the correspondence rules and source.

items.title: Gematria & isopsephy
items.summary: Letter-number interpretation within specific linguistic and textual traditions.

items.title: Onomancy
items.summary: Symbolic readings of names; correspondence rules depend on the tradition.

items.title: Kledonomancy
items.summary: Reading chance words or overheard phrases as symbolic prompts.

items.title: Cleromancy / casting lots
items.summary: An umbrella family: dice, coins and runes already cover several lot-based forms.

items.title: Belomancy
items.summary: Historical readings involving arrows or their selection; can be studied through records.

items.title: Ifa, diloggun & named casting systems
items.summary: Distinct community-specific traditions rather than interchangeable generic oracles; each needs its own sources and context.

title: Body, gesture & creative attention
scope: HUMAN & HAND SCALES / HISTORICAL AND CONTEMPLATIVE PRACTICES

items.title: Physiognomy & metoposcopy
items.summary: Historical readings of facial or forehead features; appearance does not establish character or destiny.

items.title: Graphology
items.summary: Interpretations of handwriting, distinct from automatic writing; a historical and symbolic topic here.

items.title: Hand and body movement journals
items.summary: Structured gesture records extending the existing kinesthesia field note.

items.title: Automatic music & improvisation
items.summary: A creative counterpart to automatic writing and painting; retain the recording before interpretation.

items.title: Guided imagery & pathworking
items.summary: Structured imaginative journeys with their script and interpretive framework recorded.

items.title: Labyrinth walking
items.summary: A contemplative movement practice; an adjacent art rather than a forecasting system.

title: Landscape, weather & animal signs
scope: EARTH SCALE / DOCUMENTED CUSTOMS AND OBSERVATION

items.title: Augury / ornithomancy
items.summary: Historical interpretations of birds, calls or flight; distinguish them from ecological field observations.

items.title: Alectryomancy, hippomancy & ichthyomancy
items.summary: Historical readings involving fowl, horses or fish; study documented accounts without disturbing animals.

items.title: Nephomancy
items.summary: Symbolic cloud readings, an extension of the existing weather field note.

items.title: Brontomancy
items.summary: Historical interpretations of thunder; retain the cultural source and meteorological context.

items.title: Scapulimancy & plastromancy
items.summary: Historical oracle readings of shoulder blades or shells, studied through museum records and existing objects.

items.title: Extispicy / hepatoscopy
items.summary: Historical readings of internal organs, treated as an archival topic using documented objects and texts.

items.title: Tarot, Lenormand, Sibilla & playing-card systems
items.summary: Separate branches of the existing Cards page; name the deck and interpretive system.

items.title: Astragalomancy
items.summary: Knucklebone or lot readings related to the existing Dice page.

items.title: Rhabdomancy & rod methods
items.summary: A family already partly covered by Radiesthesia / dowsing; link as a variant.

items.title: Horary, electional, natal & mundane astrology
items.summary: Branches for the existing astrology space, with explicit chart settings and sources.

items.title: Astrocartography & planetary hours
items.summary: Further astrological mapping and timing systems; record their conventions.

items.title: Tasseography variants
items.summary: Tea leaves and coffee grounds are already present; regional preparation and reading methods could have their own notes.
